meta_title: Eden's by Adam | Landscape Gardener Nottingham
meta_description: Eden's by Adam delivers bespoke garden design and landscaping across Nottingham. Expert planting, patios, and maintenance. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning outdoor spaces, we design and build gardens that work for your home and your life.
services_heading: Complete Garden Design & Landscaping Services Across Nottingham
services_subhead: Whether you need a total garden overhaul, a new patio, or ongoing maintenance, we handle every aspect of outdoor design with care and expertise.

services.title: Bespoke Garden Design
services.desc: Custom layouts tailored to your space, style, and budget. We listen to your vision and create plans you'll love living with.

services.title: Patio & Hardscaping
services.desc: Professionally laid patios, pathways, and raised beds using quality materials that last. Perfect for entertaining or quiet retreat.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Expert selection and planting of trees, shrubs, and perennials chosen for your soil and light conditions. Low-maintenance schemes available.

services.title: Lawn Care & Establishment
services.desc: New lawn installation or restoration of tired grass. We prepare soil properly and advise on feeding and seasonal care.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular pruning, weeding, and seasonal tidying to keep your garden looking its best year-round. Flexible monthly or quarterly visits.

services.title: Decking & Water Features
services.desc: Timber decking, pergolas, and water features that add structure and character. Built to withstand Nottingham weather.

about_pullquote: I started because I believe every garden deserves to be beautiful, not just surviving.
about_para_1: Eden's by Adam was founded 15 years ago with a simple mission: create outdoor spaces that improve the way people live. Adam trained in horticulture and landscape design, and over a decade and a half has transformed over 450 gardens across Nottingham. From small terraced backyards to sprawling country plots, every project gets the same attention to detail and personal touch.
about_para_2: We're known locally for listening first, designing second, and delivering gardens that genuinely reflect how our customers want to use their outdoor space. Many of our clients return for seasonal maintenance or to expand their schemes—that repeat business is our best endorsement. We're proud to be a one-person operation; you always deal directly with Adam, not a call centre.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Eden's by Adam

reviews.text: Adam completely redesigned our back garden—it was just overgrown mess before. He listened to what we wanted, came up with a proper plan, and the finished result is absolutely stunning. Spent a lot of time explaining plant choices and how to maintain it. Best investment we've made in the house.
reviews.author: Martin H.

reviews.text: Had a new patio laid and some borders planted. Adam was tidy, punctual, and knew exactly what he was doing. The patio's level, the plants are thriving, and he even showed me how to deadhead them properly. Would recommend without hesitation.
reviews.author: Rachel K.

reviews.text: We've had Adam round quarterly for maintenance—pruning, weeding, seasonal tidy-ups. He's reliable, friendly, and honest. Garden looks cared for all year round. You deal with him directly, no hassle. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: David T.
